gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla keeps its s curves wide and barely curled in. Warnes is the livelier partner, one thread of ink with no swelling, tapering off before the strokes meet, while the body stays approachable and low.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-devanagari: Expressive, bold Warnes draws every stem like rope. Anek Devanagari follows in open-mouthed, tall-middled sans letters, so a longer passage moves along easily without any of the heading's drama creeping in.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati reads as a clean, plain sans with a gaping c. Over a longer passage its lowercase, nearly as big as the capitals, feels approachable, while Warnes lets its strokes run without any thick-to-thin shading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Warnes draws horizontals and verticals as identical rod stock. Anek Gurmukhi, a plain sans with big open counters and generous round curves, would carry a longer passage in a clean, professional way.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-kannada: Tall, blocky, and bold. Warnes keeps one monoweight stroke throughout, and Anek Kannada, a sans-serif with a high x-height and terminals stopping far from the stem, takes over the quieter text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-malayalam: Warnes gives its crossbars as much fat as the stems they join. Anek Malayalam, a plain sans with a minimal gap between x-height and caps, settles beneath it with curve tips that never touch.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-odia: Warnes bends its s curves like wire, never thinning at the spine. Anek Odia, a sans with rounds left unlatched like a hook, follows it with capitals only slightly above lowercase.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-tamil: Big round bowls, one rolling-ball trail. Warnes writes with a single width of stroke, and Anek Tamil, a sans with half-unwrapped c and s shapes, would read a longer passage in a modern, contemporary way.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu builds its reading rhythm on wide, tall bowls and rounds that stay unsealed like an unlatched hook, as a sans-serif. Over a longer stretch it feels clean and approachable, a gentle foil to Warnes with its crossbars as thick as its stems.
